data.narrative:
Specter Aerospace is a Series C-stage space and aerospace company founded by Felipe Gomez del Campo and Drew Weibel that has raised $14.4M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comparable universe of 6 same-sector, same/adjacent-stage private companies (Sierra Space, Apex Space, Cowboy Space Corporation, Varda Space Industries, Aalyria, and one additional peer) plus 5 public Space & Aerospace benchmarks (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL).

Two triangulation methods are applicable. The stage-progression approach applies a 1.7x multiplier to total capital raised as a proxy for base value, yielding $24M. The peer-median method references 6 private comparables in Space & Aerospace at Series B through Series D, which show a median valuation of $1.8B with a range spanning $1.15B to $8.0B. Public-comp anchoring cannot be applied due to absence of disclosed revenue. 

Integrating both methods produces a valuation range of $21M (floor) to $2.1B (ceiling), with a midpoint of $907M. The wide dispersion reflects material uncertainty around stage-specific risk, market timing, and whether Specter's commercial traction and technical differentiation align with high-end peers like Sierra Space ($8.0B) or lower-quartile entrants. Further diligence on revenue, customer pipeline, and capital efficiency trajectory would narrow this band materially.
